title: Blueberry & lemon friands
hookLine: Australian-inspired blueberry & lemon friands with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to fan 180C/conventional 200C/gas 6. Generously butter six non-stick friand or muffin tins. Melt the butter and set aside to cool. Incorporate {m53100_1}, {m53100_2}, {m53100_3}, and {m53100_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure unsalted butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Sift the icing sugar and flour into a bowl. Add the almonds and mix everything between your fingers. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m53100_5}, {m53100_6}, and {m53100_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk the egg whites in another bowl until they form a light, floppy foam. Make a well in the centre of the dry ingredients, tip in the egg whites and lemon rind, then lightly stir in the butter to form a soft batter.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Divide the batter among the tins, a large serving spoon is perfect for this job. Sprinkle a handful of blueberries over each cake and bake for 15-20 minutes until just firm to the touch and golden brown.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Cool in the tins for 5 minutes, then turn out and cool on a wire rack. To serve, dust lightly with icing sugar. Let Blueberry & lemon friands cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 4 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
